description: Changes a flow's name or description, as its editor on the Automations page does. Send only what changes. Its steps and how it starts are set in the editor (how it starts: set_flow_start). flow_id comes from read('flows'). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_flow
title: Rename a flow or change its description
